The '''Maltorian system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Lifh sector/Legends|Lifh sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained [[Maltoria]] and the [[Maltorian Mining Belt]].<ref name="TJK" />
